name: FEA-Bench-v1.0-Standard
description: FEA-Bench-v1.0-Standard evaluates an LLM's ability to generate correct finite-element-analysis (FEA) code and produce numerically accurate simulation outputs. Tasks require producing runnable scientific code or numerical solutions which are validated via execution and numerical comparison against reference solutions. The benchmark focuses on engineering/scientific-computing competence, numerical methods, and domain-specific reasoning in FEA.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark used in scientific code-generation research with limited but growing adoption among researchers working on engineering/physics code generation.
